{"accion":"consultar","hipotesis":"H2","sql":"WITH disputas AS (
  SELECT d.id, d.reason, d.status,
         c.risk_level, c.ip_country, c.billing_country,
         e.transportista, e.region, e.estado,
         CASE WHEN to_timestamp(d.created) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-16 00:00:00' THEN 'segunda_quincena' ELSE 'primera_quincena' END AS quincena
  FROM crudo.pagos_disputes d
  JOIN crudo.pagos_charges c ON d.charge = c.id
  LEFT JOIN crudo.envios e ON c.metadata__order_id = e.nro_pedido
  WHERE to_timestamp(d.created) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
    AND to_timestamp(d.created) <= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-30 23:59:59'
)
SELECT quincena,
  risk_level,
  ip_country,
  billing_country,
  transportista,
  region,
  count(*) AS disputas
FROM disputas
GROUP BY quincena, risk_level, ip_country, billing_country, transportista, region
ORDER BY quincena, disputas DESC;"}
